spark: Hronolf walked out on his raiding pack rather than burn a mill with a family inside, and the pack's leader swore to collect on it

focal.name: Hronolf
focal.who: A wolfman who left a raiding pack and will not say why.
focal.backstory: Hronolf ran with a wolfman raiding pack in the high pines until the night he refused to burn a mill with a family inside. The pack's leader, his own cousin, swore in front of the whole pack to collect on it.
